lines.zh: 我的小骨腿踩得咔咔响。
lines.en: My little bone legs click with every step.
I hop and my ribs rattle along.
Running, I sound like snapping bamboo.
I keep up with you in short little steps.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在石头上打滑。
lines.en: My toe bones slip on the stone.

lines.zh: 我跳过低洼处的岩浆沟。
lines.en: I leap across the lava channel below.
I shake ash off as I walk.

lines.zh: 我骨节里卡着下界的沙。
lines.en: Nether sand is stuck in my joints.

lines.zh: 我走路没有影子的重量。
lines.en: My walk carries no shadow's weight.

lines.zh: 我的髋骨晃得快要散开。
lines.en: My hip bones rattle almost loose.

lines.zh: 我小跑着绕到石头后面。
lines.en: I trot around behind a rock.
I limp on one leg and keep going.
I tap my teeth with a finger bone.

lines.zh: 我数肋骨的缝打发时间。
lines.en: I count the gaps between my ribs.
Lava creeps along beside my feet.
I crouch and pick up a hot stone.
There is no wind in my eye sockets.
I tilt my skull to one side and listen.
I draw a circle in the ash.
Hot wind passes through my spine.
I chew a piece of charred bone.

lines.zh: 我站着让火从我背上过。
lines.en: I stand still and let fire wash over my back.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里露出半个头骨。
lines.en: Half my skull shows from the crack.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子响一声。
lines.en: I look up; my neck clicks once.
You are so much taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的骨头挂饰。
lines.en: I stare at the bone charms on your belt.

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在算你的尺寸。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if measuring you.
I know that iron in your hand.

lines.zh: 我的下颌张着，忘了合上。
lines.en: My jaw hangs open; I forgot to close it.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的头转一点。
lines.en: Each of your steps turns my skull a little.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里看你的脚。
lines.en: I study your feet from inside your shadow.
I look at you and say nothing.
You knocked two ribs loose.
A hairline crack runs through my bone.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I hit the rock and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一节指骨。
lines.en: That cost me a finger joint.

lines.zh: 我喀地响了一声，站直了。
lines.en: I click once and straighten up.
You hit my shoulder; I go crooked.
Bits of me scatter on the ground.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的骨头接回去。
lines.en: I pick up my own bone and fit it back.
It is not pain so much as noise.

lines.zh: 我的头骨被敲得嗡嗡响。
lines.en: My skull rings from the blow.
I do not eat the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 我只想要你身上的骨头。
lines.en: I only want the bones you carry.
Food has no taste for me.

lines.zh: 面包举到头顶我也不看。
lines.en: Hold the bread overhead; I still will not look.
My belly is an empty shell.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是骨头的味道。
lines.en: What I smell is bone.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我只咬你的手指。
lines.en: Feed me and I will only bite your fingers.

lines.zh: 我的空腔里没有饿这回事。
lines.en: There is no hunger in my hollow ribs.
Put that food away.

lines.zh: 骨头比面包有意思多了。
lines.en: Bone is far more interesting than bread.
My shoulder bone jabs you.
The bump sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨磕在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: My ribs knock against your knee.
Like a bundle of kindling hitting you.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟碾过我的趾骨。
lines.en: Your boot heel crushes my toe bones.

lines.zh: 我的头骨撞在你护甲上。
lines.en: My skull hits your armor.
One bump and a few of my joints slip.
You block; I back off.

lines.zh: 我的骨头顶得你后退半步。
lines.en: My bones push you back half a step.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，全是咔声。
lines.en: We collide in a clatter of clicks.
These bones of mine seek no mate.

lines.zh: 另一个骨小鬼朝我敲牙。
lines.en: Another bone imp clicks its teeth at me.
We cannot make a pair.

lines.zh: 骨头和骨头碰一下就走。
lines.en: Bone meets bone and then moves on.
I have no hand to hold.
In the Nether I only look for fire.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，各自发呆。
lines.en: We stand side by side, each blank.
My bones are too light to lean on.

lines.zh: 没有谁替我留一块骨头。
lines.en: Nobody saves a bone for me.

lines.zh: 我太小了，配对轮不到我。
lines.en: I am too small to be chosen.

lines.zh: 我抱起一块比我大的骨。
lines.en: I lift a bone bigger than I am.
I carry it clamped under my jaw.
I can manage that lump of coal.

lines.zh: 我举到一半，胳膊撑不住。
lines.en: Halfway up, my arm bones give out.
I tuck it between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆里扒出一块铁。
lines.en: I dig a piece of iron from the ash.

lines.zh: 我的指骨夹不住细东西。
lines.en: My finger bones cannot hold small things.
If it drops, I pick it up again.
I pick up bones and nothing else.
Carrying something slows my run.

lines.zh: 你的骨头在衣服下面响。
lines.en: Your bones shift under your clothes.
I smell the sweetness of living bone.
You will do; your bones are fresh.
I stand up out of the ash pile.

lines.zh: 你身上的温度我记住了。
lines.en: I have your warmth memorized now.
I hop two steps toward you.
Not much lives down here.
My teeth are starting to itch.
You crushed the bone pile I arranged.
I have chosen you; do not leave.
I fix on the spot above your knee.
I hear your joints creaking.
I begin counting your ribs.

lines.zh: 个子大没用，我钻得进去。
lines.en: Size is useless; I can slip inside.

lines.zh: 你的小腿在抖，我先看见了。
lines.en: Your legs are trembling, and I saw it first.
I crouch and my joints pull tight.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I hug the ground and slip to your flank.
Look down; I am at your feet.
I wait for your knee to bend.
I have the jump distance worked out.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在脚踝处有缝。
lines.en: Your armor has a gap at the ankle.
I click my teeth, once, then again.
If you will not come down, I will come up.
I circle inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 火在我背后烧着，我不怕。
lines.en: Fire burns behind me; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我等着你转身的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you turn.
My finger bones are already spread.
You retreat; I follow one step.
I am waiting for your heel to show.

lines.zh: 我躲在你影子里，跟着走。
lines.en: I hide in your shadow and follow.
I count the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 你的靴子有一条缝，我记着。
lines.en: Your boot has a seam, and I remember it.
I shift left, and you look left.
I leap and bite your calf.

lines.zh: 我的指骨抠进你的靴缝。
lines.en: My fingers dig into your boot seam.

lines.zh: 我用头骨撞你的膝盖，火星四溅。
lines.en: I ram your knee with my skull, sparks flying.
I claw once and come away with threads.
Once my teeth close, they stay closed.
I rake upward along your leg.
You kick; I roll away and come back.

lines.zh: 我把你脚边的石头掀起来。
lines.en: I flip the stone beside your foot.

lines.zh: 我的骨节在你皮肤上刮。
lines.en: My joints scrape across your skin.
After biting I hop back two steps.

lines.zh: 我全身的重量都压上去。
lines.en: I throw all my weight into it.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的裤脚往下拽。
lines.en: I grab your trouser leg and pull.
I am small, but I bite true.
Did you hear that click?

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，挂在那儿。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and hang on there.
I drive my elbow bone into the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边的灰里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the ash beside the lava.

lines.zh: 我的头骨先顶开了碎石。
lines.en: My skull pushes the gravel aside first.

lines.zh: 下界的石头缝里响了一声。
lines.en: Something clicks in a Nether crack.

lines.zh: 我从熄灭的火堆里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from a dying fire pit.
I shake the bone dust off.
I slide down the blackstone wall.

lines.zh: 又一个骨小鬼凑齐了骨头。
lines.en: Another bone imp pulls itself together.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，我一点也不疼。
lines.en: Fire bakes me and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里捞起自己的腿。
lines.en: I fish my own leg out of the lava.
This place is hot; it suits me.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在热风里发干。
lines.en: My bones dry in the hot wind.

lines.zh: 我从传送门那边挤过来。
lines.en: I squeeze through from the other side.
I climb up on a floating stone.
The ash settles; I am still here.

lines.zh: 我在火里站着，火伤不到我。
lines.en: I stand in the fire and it cannot hurt me.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，散了半边。
lines.en: I fall from a height and half of me scatters.
The water makes my bones heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我拆成一堆散骨。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into loose bones.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肋骨，钉在后面。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my ribs behind me.

lines.zh: 魔法把我骨缝里的火按灭了。
lines.en: Magic smothers the fire in my joints.
I have no flesh to waste away.
Lightning hits me; my bones turn white.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，骨头还在咔咔响。
lines.en: I fall away, bones still clicking.
